import pyautogui; pyautogui.click(1200, 400); pyautogui.sleep(1); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); pyautogui.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.write('Sub DoReorder
Dim oDoc, oComps, oComp, i, j, k, s, cur, nm, u, tg, ac, fd, rn
nm = Array("ReadMe","Raw_data","Beans","Millet","Sorghum","Mkt Gotheye","Mkt Mangaize","Mkt Ouallam","Mkt Tera","Millet spatial integration")
oComps = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
On Error Resume Next
Do While oComps.hasMoreElements()
oComp = oComps.nextElement()
u = ""
u = oComp.getURL()
If InStr(u, "workbook-with-sample-database") > 0 Then oDoc = oComp
Loop
On Error Goto 0
s = ""
For i = 0 To UBound(nm)
tg = LCase(Join(Split(nm(i)," "),""))
fd = -1
For j = i To oDoc.Sheets.Count - 1
ac = LCase(Join(Split(Trim(oDoc.Sheets.getByIndex(j).Name)," "),""))
If ac = tg Then fd = j
Next j
If fd >= 0 Then
rn = oDoc.Sheets.getByIndex(fd).Name
oDoc.Sheets.moveByName(rn, i)
Else
s = s & "MISSING " & nm(i) & Chr(10)
End If
Next i
cur = ""
For k = 0 To oDoc.Sheets.Count - 1
cur = cur & k & "=" & oDoc.Sheets.getByIndex(k).Name & Chr(10)
Next k
If s = "" Then
oDoc.store()
s = "SAVED" & Chr(10)
End If
MsgBox s & cur
End Sub', interval=0.01); pyautogui.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('f5'); pyautogui.sleep(3)
